items.title: Simon damage tally rises: 201 homes in 21 Guerrero municipalities; Acapulco rainfall record
items.summary: Guerrero Civil Protection's latest assessment raises Simon's toll to 201 damaged homes across 21 municipalities (6 fully collapsed, 182 flooded, 13 more with landslide or structural damage), up from 112 in 20 municipalities. Acapulco is the hardest-hit municipality (2 injured, 20 homes flooded, 150 businesses waterlogged, 60 vehicles stranded) and set an all-time rainfall record at 391 mm, with up to 500 mm suspected. Mexico's SMN forecasts Simon degrading to Category 1 Tuesday-Wednesday and making landfall in Sinaloa around midnight Thursday, Oct 15, with direct effects on Mazatlan at lower intensity (~160 km/h gusts). Simon's death toll remains 2 (Chilpancingo wall-collapse victim + Mazatlan cliff diver).
